ART STYLE (the attached APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp is the final look: match its cleanliness, pixel size, shading and outline EXACTLY; the other style image is only an early concept for mood):
- CLEAN, HIGH-QUALITY 2D pixel art for an arcade brawler, matching the APPROVED STYLE reference (codex/refs/style/APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp) EXACTLY: a clean, polished, less-pixelated look with fine pixel blocks, smooth tidy edges, soft readable cel shading, crisp outlines. NOT chunky or blocky, NOT noisy, NO blur, NO painterly smoothing, NO 3D render look, NO gradients (use clean 3-4 tone cel shading and a bright rim light).
- Pixel size: fine and uniform, each visible pixel block about 4x4 px on the 1024x1024 canvas (a 256x256 logical grid). Keep the SAME pixel size in every image of every character so frames never mix pixel sizes. Clean lines, no stray single-pixel noise, no dithering clutter on faces.
- Detail level of the approved reference: clean expressive faces (eyes, brows, glasses glints, beard texture), readable fabric folds and seams, gold/teal trim lines, metallic highlights on gear. Same arcade proportions: slightly enlarged head, hands and boots.
- Dark navy outline #0B1026 (never pure black) around every shape, 1 pixel block thick, slightly thicker on the outer silhouette.
- Shading: 3 tones + 1 highlight per material, cel style. Key light warm from the top-left (#FFC857), cool TEAL rim light from the back-right (#2EE6D6).
- Vibrant but controlled palette (about 32 colours per character): TranTech navy #14213D / near-black polo #121B33, teal #19D3C5 and #2EE6D6, amber #FFA31A, warm gold #FFC857, electric blue #3EA6FF, LED green #4DFF88, cream #F6EAD2, skin tones with warm rosy mid-tones. Saturation about 15% higher than the concept image, never neon-garish.
- Brand: the uniform is a dark navy-black polo/top with the TranTech logo patch on the left chest: a small wide RECTANGLE with a teal outline and a tiny white word-mark (do not try to write legible text, a few pixels suggesting letters is right).

CHARACTER: AIDEN, "The Full-Stack Tank" (Heavy hitter (programmer)). A stylised arcade-hero caricature of a REAL TranTech staff member, so the face and body must be recognisably THEM, flattering and fun.
REFERENCE PHOTO: attached as codex/refs/photos/aiden.jpeg. Study it for face shape, hair, facial hair, glasses, skin tone, build and expression. Do not copy the photo's background or clothes literally; convert into the game style.
BUILD: tall, broad, big and sturdy, the heavy of the crew; oversized fists; the largest hero sprite (about 115% of Zac height).
LIKENESS (must be recognisable): DARK BROWN TOUSLED MEDIUM-LENGTH HAIR, messy volume, swept up and back, a loose curl falling forward. BLACK THICK RECTANGULAR GLASSES. Dark moustache joined to a neat dark GOATEE / chin-and-jaw beard (cheeks mostly clean). Fair-to-light skin with warm cheeks, big warm toothy GRIN, friendly brown eyes, a gentle-giant face.
OUTFIT: TranTech navy polo (stretched over broad shoulders) with a light-blue inner collar and logo patch on the left chest, heavy dark cargo trousers with knee pads, big steel-toe boots, utility harness straps over the shoulders carrying small blinking server modules.
SIGNATURE WEAPON: a pair of mini rack-server GAUNTLETS whose screens scroll glowing source code (blinking blue and green LEDs, cables dangling), used as giant punching fists; floating curly braces { } orbit the fists on big hits.
FX COLOURS: #3EA6FF electric blue + #FFA31A amber.
PERSONALITY / SIGNATURE QUIRK (this is what makes them unique, show it in the design and every pose): Aiden is a PROGRAMMER: a gentle-giant coder whose glowing gauntlets scroll code, with floating curly braces, semicolons and bug icons around him.
EXTRA DETAIL: a coffee mug clipped to the harness that reads "// it works on my machine"; one gauntlet screen shows "99.99% UPTIME".

SPRITE OUTPUT RULES (the image is imported by a script, so these are not optional):
1. Canvas exactly 1024x1024, background ONE flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Nothing else in the background: no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no gradient, no border, no text, no labels, no pose number, no watermark. The character must contain NO magenta, hot pink or purple-pink pixels (the keying colour).
2. ONE pose only. One character only. No turnaround, no collage, no second figure.
3. The character FACES RIGHT (towards the right edge of the canvas).
4. Scale: the standing/idle height is 640 px x 1.15 = about 735 px tall (the biggest hero) (see per-character note) on this 1024 canvas: use the SAME scale in every frame of this character, never zoom per pose. Feet (soles) rest on the horizontal line y=960 whenever the pose is grounded; the body centre (the hips) sits on the vertical line x=512. In air poses keep the same centre and scale.
5. Keep the whole figure and all weapons/hair fully inside the canvas with at least 40 px free on every side.
6. Do not draw attack effects, trails, projectiles, impact bursts, motion lines, dust or shadows in the character image: those are separate images (fx_*). The only exceptions are the tiny sparkles/stars that the pose text explicitly asks for.
7. Likeness, outfit, proportions, colours, tattoos, glasses, hair and logo patch must be IDENTICAL to the approved design sheet and to the previous frames. If a frame disagrees with the sheet, the frame is wrong: regenerate it.

POSE TO DRAW (this single image only): TAUNT frame 2 of 2: the punchline pose of the taunt, a big expression.

Move names for context: melee "Hard Reboot", combo finisher "Compile", special "Blue Screen", ultimate "Kernel Panic". Melee = "Hard Reboot": a huge overhand server-fist slam with a blue code-glyph shockwave and flying screws. Special = "Blue Screen": claps the gauntlets and fires a big slow blue-screen panel with a sad-face glyph and scrolling stack-trace text, crackling with static. Ultimate = "Kernel Panic": Aiden raises both gauntlets, a giant red POWER button forms overhead with falling code, he slams it and the whole stage shakes in a blue-white pulse of "ERROR" glyphs.
